title: Effect of Uro-Vaxom® immunomodulation on recurrent urinary tract infections: a retrospective real-world analysis
summary:
This retrospective observational study investigates how the frequency of recurrent urinary tract infections changes after treatment with Uro-Vaxom® in routine care and how long any potential benefit lasts.

Existing medical records of adult patients prescribed Uro-Vaxom® at a urology practice since 2024 will be reviewed. A one-time questionnaire will provide additional information on infections, quality of life, medicine use, side effects, booster courses and other preventive measures.

Treatment was prescribed independently of the study. No medicines will be administered or additional medical examinations performed.

interventions.name: All patients who have received immunisation with Uro-Vaxom© since 01/01/2024 in routine urological care
